changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionItem]( [ExecutionId] [int] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] sparse, [Properties] [nvarchar](max) constraint DF_ApiExecutionItem_Properties default('{}') NOT NULL, [CustomProperties] [nvarchar](max) constraint DF_ApiExecutionItem_CustomProperties default('[]') NOT NULL, [AdditionalImpactedItems] [nvarchar](max) sparse, [Message] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, constraint [PK_ApiExecutionItem] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionId] ASC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END GO
alter table api.ExecutionItem alter column ExecutionItemUid uniqueidentifier null GO
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE name = 'DF_ApiExecutionItem_ExecutionItemUid') BEGIN alter table api.ExecutionItem add constraint DF_ApiExecutionItem_ExecutionItemUid default(newid()) for ExecutionItemUid; END GO

changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE name = 'DF_ApiExecutionItem_ExecutionItemUid') BEGIN alter table api.ExecutionItem DROP constraint DF_ApiExecutionItem_ExecutionItemUid; END IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE name = 'DF_ApiExecutionItem_ExecutionItemUid') BEGIN alter table api.ExecutionItem add constraint DF_ApiExecutionItem_ExecutionItemUid default(cast('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' as uniqueidentifier)) for ExecutionItemUid; END GO
